node.text:
A day I will never forget

Starting on the left wing for @bristolcityfc with a superb group of club legends and local celebrities, with my family and friends in the stands 

Raising awareness and money for mental health with @talkclubcharity @bristolcityrobinsfoundation @bristolroversct who put on such a fantastic event 

I am very grateful to be in this position

I started both of my YouTube channels in times of difficult mental health personally

Both times I found some help - spoke about my problems, got them all out there + channeled all the negative energy into something positive and productive 

It’s good to talk

Well today we just hit 30,000 subscribers on the Golden Goal channel which absolutely mental 

I couldn’t be more thankful for everyone that has watched and been a part of the journey 

What started as a podcast with @iam_samguy in my bedroom in Yeovil recorded on a MacBook webcam has built a channel with more subscribers than would fit into Ashton Gate. It’s hard to put that into perspective when I just sit in my bedroom behind a camera and screen! 

It’s now become a little business with my good mate @fpltom_ too

My life has changed so much during that time - but one thing that’s stayed a constant is this channel 

I have sacrificed quite a lot to stay consistent with making videos, and for quite a lot of the time no one really watched any of them, but I just had a calling to keep going - and for those that have been with me since day 1, I couldn’t be more grateful.

I never envisaged doing anything like this when I was growing up - but here we are. The battle against the cringe of putting myself out there online on some interesting thumbnails has been won.

Lets keep going

Hit 3,000 subs on the Robins Nest channel this morning!

It’s honestly quite unbelievable what’s happened since I made that Liam Manning video last year

Thank you everyone for the support - I hope I’m returning the favour with some decent videos

I am extremely grateful

Recorded a Bristol City chat with @unknownrgram yesterday

Great to see him again after the Talk Club Cup back in May

He’s a top lad, great to meet the team he has behind the scenes too 

Keep an eye out for when it drops 👀

Season starts next week wtf

(Sign a contract pls Max Bird)

Last night during a 5 hour long deadline stream for World Cup fantasy we hit 25,000 subscribers on the Golden Goal channel!!

Insane 

Very grateful I get to do this as part of my living now - thank you all x

A few more pictures from the game

Still buzzing - what a day

Tomorrow will be a dream come true playing for Bristol City in the Talk Club Cup alongside some of the players I watched at Wembley nearly 20 years ago now

Raising money for 3 fantastic organisations @bristolcityrobinsfoundation @bristolroversct @talkclubcharity - helping them get men talking about their mental health

I am extremely grateful to be in this position - thank you 

There’s still time to get your tickets - link is in my bio

Feeling a bit reflective as the football season draws to a close 

The support and growth I’ve seen on both of my channels has quite frankly been unbelievable this year - grateful to everyone that watches and those that have helped me on the journey 

Created lots of memories through FPL, following Bristol City home and away (as much as possible) and even dabbled in a bit of radio this season

Mostly though I am grateful for those I have been able to share the journey with, whether that be those that I’ve worked with or those that watch

I’ve never worked harder in my life than I currently am and I’m spinning way too many plates, but I wouldn’t change it for the world 

Never in a million years did I see myself getting on camera and becoming a YouTuber but here we are 

You FPL reds

A few days in Budapest to recharge the batteries🔋 

I still can’t believe Roy Hodgson is our manager - must be AI
